commits.message:
feat(examples): terminal-host demo replaces the BrowserTerminalHost harness (rich-demos-k78j.9yz)

The harness exercised BrowserTerminalHost, which the card now builds for every
program. terminal-host is the same contract as a demo: a key inspector written
against TerminalHost alone, run on NodeTerminalHost by main.ts (card and
npm run terminal-host) and on BrowserTerminalHost by embed.ts, which a unit
test drives on a fake xterm. The harness's own files stay until 7qo: they are
the iframe bundler's last input, and removing them breaks demos:build.

feat(docs): claude-sessions runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.dja) (#370)

* feat(docs): claude-sessions runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.dja)

main.ts runs the session browser on fixture.ts's one-session tree in the
card; node.ts runs it on ~/.claude/projects for npm run sessions. wire.ts
and index.ts gone, library imported by published names.

* fix(examples): claude-sessions imports FileSystem directly, drops the dead barrel; one law token across demos (rich-demos-k78j.dja)
